product_metadata.title: TIMBER RIDGE 20 oz Insulated Tumblers, Stainless Steel Coffee Cup with Easy-Open Lid, Dishwasher Safe,Double Wall Vacuum
features: DESIGNED FOR EASY DRINKING: The US Patented Pop-up Lid takes barely any effort to remove, you could do it with one hand/finger and the coat with sweat-free design keeps your hands dry and easy to clean.

VACUUM INSULATION: Double-walled vacuum insulated tumbler with copper lining offers maximum temperature control; it keeps beverages cold or hot with 6H>151°F (203°F filled with water, 68°F at room temperature)

FOOD-GRADE MATERIAL: 20 oz insulated tumbler is made from food-grade plastic PCT (Tritan) and food-grade silicone. The 18/8 stainless steel liner and bottle makes 20 oz coffee mug BPA-free and dishwasher safe.

TRIPLE LAYER BASE: 20 oz coffee tumbler with a triple-layer base for extra durability and to reduce abrasion and collision damage; triple layer also reduces the noise caused by friction with desktops and can prolong the bottle's life, perfect for the office, camping and driving.

MANUFACTURER'S WARRANTY: All Timber Ridge products come with a 1-year manufacturer's warranty for quality defects so you can purchase with confidence; enjoy your time outdoors and stay hydrated with Timber Ridge coffee mug.
